ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-1,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District; and M2-3, Light Industry District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 8-l in the area bound by:

West 34" Street; a line 300 feet west of and parallel to the alley next west of and parallel
to South Western Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 34" Street; a line
241.75 feet west of and parallel to the alley next west of and parallel to South Western
Avenue; West 34" Place; and the east right of way line of the Baltimore and Ohio
Chicago Terminal Railroad,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
